title: A GPU Algorithm for Detecting Strongly Connected Components
gpu_scope: ECL-SCC: GPU strongly-connected-components algorithm where all vertices concurrently act as pivots; on par with the fastest prior GPU code on power-law graphs and 7.8x faster on mesh graphs.
notes: From the same ECL (Texas State) lab behind ECL-MaxFlow and ECL-SGB already validated/catalogued elsewhere in this project.
